common: Use case: stylized-concept. One EMPTY landscape background for a narrative anime RPG, 16:9 2560x1440 PNG, no characters, no people, no text or UI. pose: Quiet froststone courtyard adjoining workshop after battle, huge gate standing safely open toward a lamplit street, subtle frost remaining only at stone edges, a few broken ink-paper/brass enemy fragments near distant wall, no human faces/bodies/blood. Empty broad flat foreground inviting someone to stand side by side, dim blue evening, restrained warm window light and teal memory flecks. No shield painted into background.
